description: This file defines an object-oriented PHP controller class for managing CMS topics within an OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting topics, handling request parameters, loading models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS topics, extending the core OpenCart Controller class and providing methods for CRUD operations, status toggling, and rendering views related to topics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that prepares data and loads the main topics list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to return the list of topics.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the data for listing topics, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and view rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a topic, loading necessary data and configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new or existing topic, including validation and model interaction.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected topics by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected topics by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected topics from the database.
